implementation.factory: The central request method pins every Factory read/mutation/cleanup to the already verified personal Workspace. Existing selector header, all query workspaceId values and body workspaceId must agree; session, Origin and normal endpoint authorization remain. No fallback to another scope.
implementation.idle: Fresh active-membership inventory then two existing empty-args readers per scope, then a second inventory with equal sorted ID/kind set. Bounds: 32 scopes, each result <200 rows, one 30s scan deadline. Require complete full snapshots, own user/selected workspace live scope, known statuses and IDs, exact thread version/positions. A visible row expiry cannot be ignored. Reject revocation, inventory changes, incomplete state or elapsed/backwards clock.
implementation.report: Counts only existing 30-day visible scope and explicitly states workspaceScanAtomic=false. No atomic membership/work lock or all-history coverage claimed.
implementation.boundaries: No product endpoint/UI/SQL/schema/polling change. Only acceptance preparation/restoration adds bounded normal authenticated reads. Product default selection finding remains independently owned by P0.
